stem.text: Which dot-and-cross diagram is correct for $\text{Al}_2\text{Cl}_6$?

A.alt: Dot-and-cross diagram: two bracketed Al ions with charge 3+ and six bracketed Cl ions with charge 1-, each with its electrons drawn as crosses (Al) or circles (Cl)

B.alt: Dot-and-cross diagram of Al2Cl6: two Al atoms, each surrounded by Cl atoms, with shared electrons drawn as crosses and circles

C.alt: Dot-and-cross diagram of Al2Cl6: two Al atoms, each surrounded by Cl atoms, with shared electrons drawn as crosses and circles

D.alt: Dot-and-cross diagram of Al2Cl6: two Al atoms side by side, each surrounded by Cl atoms, with shared electrons drawn as crosses and circles
